children: Follows major Ho Chi Minh City hotel partnership (New World Saigon), accelerating Coway's regional B2B growth across Vietnam's key hospitality hubs
Equips guest rooms at Prince Hotel Da Nang along My Khe Beach with 164 units of Coway's award-winning non-electric water purifier 'P-350N'
Advances Seibu Prince Hotels & Resorts' ESG commitments by eliminating 108,000 single-use plastic bottles annually
Ensures worry-free hygiene via Coway's signature 'Heart Service'—regular professional care by Cody experts

DA NANG, Vietnam, Aug. 31, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Coway Vina, the Vietnam subsidiary of Coway (South Korea's "Best Life Solution Company"), has partnered with Prince Hotel Da Nang, operated by Seibu Prince Hotels & Resorts and prime-located along My Khe Beach, to advance eco-friendly hospitality. Under this partnership, Coway completed the installation of 164 units of Coway P-350N premium water purifiers across guest accommodations.

This partnership marks another significant milestone in Coway Vina's rapid expansion across Vietnam's premium hospitality sector. Following its successful deployment at major luxury properties such as New World Saigon Hotel in Ho Chi Minh City, Coway is extending its presence to Da Nang, Vietnam's premier coastal resort destination, reinforcing its position as the preferred eco-friendly water solution for major international hotel chains.
Premium Water Filtration and Worry-Free Maintenance for Luxury Hotels

The installed Coway P-350N is an ultra-compact (13 cm width), non-electric unit recognized with IDEA and Good Design Awards. Designed for luxury room interiors, it pairs intuitive dial controls with multi-stage filtration to deliver fresh drinking water efficiently.

To guarantee optimal performance, Coway provides its signature 'Heart Service.' Specialized Cody (Coway Lady) experts visit every six months for filter replacements and deep-cleaning, allowing hotel staff to focus entirely on guest care without operational burdens.
Driving Actionable ESG Practices Across Vietnam's Hospitality Sector

As part of its rebranding from the local 'Sel de Mer Hotel & Suites' to the global 'Prince Hotel Da Nang,' the resort has seized the opportunity to modernize its guest experience while prioritizing sustainability. Aligning with global ESG trends, the hotel transitioned from providing single-use bottled water to installing Coway's in-room water purifiers.

This strategic upgrade significantly enhances guest convenience while delivering a tangible environmental impact: it eliminates the annual consumption of 108,000 plastic water bottles, effectively streamlining resort operations and reducing carbon emissions associated with bottle transport and waste management. Through this initiative, the hotel reinforces its commitment to eco-conscious hospitality, setting a new standard for sustainable luxury in Da Nang.

"Partnering with Prince Hotel Da Nang allows us to align Coway's signature 'Heart Service' with Seibu Prince's renowned 'Service from the Heart' philosophy," said Junhee Oh, CSO of Coway Vina. "We remain committed to delivering eco-friendly wellness solutions that elevate guest experiences while empowering hotel partners to meet their ESG commitments."
For additional detail, please visit https://cowayvina.com.vn/
About Coway Vina Co., Ltd.
Established in 2020, Coway Vina is the Vietnam subsidiary of Coway Co., Ltd. (

) — South Korea's "Best Life Solution Company." Dedicated to delivering healthy and comfortable living environments through innovative home appliances, including water and air purifiers alongside professional maintenance services, Coway Vina brings premium wellness solutions to homes and businesses across Vietnam. For more information, please visit the official Coway Vina website.
About Prince Hotel Da Nang

Officially opened in October 2025, marking a significant step in Seibu Prince Hotels & Resorts' renewed focus on international growth and global portfolio expansion. The hotel will bring the brand's renowned "Service from the Heart," inspired by the Japanese spirit of Omotenashi, with the entire team having received extensive training as part of a global network of hotels. The property features 164 rooms with private balconies, a diverse culinary journey across multiple on-site restaurants and bars, including the chic rooftop bar, The Speakeasy, and a stunning infinity pool.
For more information, please visit princehoteldanang.com
